items.source: In the sample above the condition will match if no bean of type MyService is already contained in the BeanFactory.
items.translation: 在上面的示例中，如果 BeanFactory 中尚未包含类型为 MyService 的 Bean，则该条件将匹配。BeanFactory

items.source: The class types of beans that should be checked. The condition matches when no bean of each class specified is contained in the BeanFactory. Beans that are not autowire candidates or that are not default candidates are ignored.
items.translation: 要检查的 Bean 类类型。当每个指定的类中都不包含 BeanFactory 中的 Bean 时，该条件匹配。不是自动装配候选项或不是默认候选项的 Bean 将被忽略。

items.source: The class type names of beans that should be checked. The condition matches when no bean of each class specified is contained in the BeanFactory. Beans that are not autowire candidates or that are not default candidates are ignored.
items.translation: 应检查的 Bean 类类型名称。当指定的每个类的 Bean 都不包含在 `BeanFactory` 中时，条件匹配。不是自动装配候选项或不是默认候选项的 Bean 将被忽略。

items.source: The annotation type decorating a bean that should be checked. The condition matches when each annotation specified is missing from all beans in the BeanFactory. Beans that are not autowire candidates or that are not default candidates are ignored.
items.translation: 装饰应进行检查的 Bean 的注解类型。当指定的每个注解都缺失于BeanFactory中的所有 Bean 时，条件匹配。非自动装配候选项或非默认候选项的 Bean 将被忽略。

items.source: The names of beans to check. The condition matches when each bean name specified is missing in the BeanFactory.
items.translation: 要检查的 Bean 名称。当指定的每个 Bean 名称在 BeanFactory 中缺失时，条件匹配。

items.source: When placed on a @Bean method and none of value(), type(), name(), or annotation() has been specified, the bean type to match defaults to the return type of the @Bean method:
items.translation: 当放置在带有 `@Bean` 的方法上，且未指定任何 `value()`、`type()`、`name()` 或 `annotation()` 时，要匹配的 Bean 类型默认为 `@Bean` 方法的返回类型：

items.source:
The condition can only match the bean definitions that have been processed by the
application context so far and, as such, it is strongly recommended to use this
condition on auto-configuration classes only. If a candidate bean may be created by
another auto-configuration, make sure that the one using this condition runs after.
items.translation: 该条件仅能匹配到目前为止已由应用程序上下文处理的 Bean 定义，因此强烈建议仅在自动配置类中使用此条件。如果候选 Bean 可能由另一个自动配置创建，请确保使用此条件的配置在其之后运行。

items.source: Additional classes that may contain the specified bean types within their generic parameters. For example, an annotation declaring value=Name.class and parameterizedContainer=NameRegistration.class would detect both Name and NameRegistration<Name>.
items.translation: 包含指定 Bean 类型在其泛型参数中的其他类。例如，一个声明了 `value=Name.class` 和 `parameterizedContainer=NameRegistration.class` 的注解将同时检测到 `Name` 和 `NameRegistration<Name>`。
